_about: Acknowledged upstream TAG MOVES (D2-17, RV2 constitution item 1; PLAN-v3 §2.8). sources_age.py --check compares every pinned spec tag's live identity (tag object sha + dereferenced commit) with SOURCES.lock.json; a move that matches an UNEXPIRED entry here on (tag, from, to, tag_object) prints 'acknowledged (decision N, review_by ...)' and keeps rc 0 — fail-noisy, not fail-blocking.
